final_message:
Configured DNS for all 40 PCs, including the requested host names and MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`.

- Root: pc1; TLDs: pc2–pc5; authoritative zones: pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc33 and pc35. Resolver: pc34.
- Created BIND configurations and zone files; updated PC startup files and the DNS servers’ images in [lab.conf](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-e_9asqbs/lab/lab.conf). Existing network addresses and routes were preserved.
- Assumed an isolated, IPv4-only DNS hierarchy. All PC startup files point to the resolver.
- BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, so zone syntax and live resolution still need external verification.
